C0543.title: Beijing Woman Swapped 121 Online Clothing Orders with Used Clothes for Refund Fraud
C0543.summary: A Beijing woman surnamed Shi used multiple accounts from 2022 to 2026 to order clothes online, then swapped the received items with used clothes to request refunds, defrauding over 20,000 yuan. In June 2026, she was criminally detained on suspicion of fraud.
